basis: Direct user confirmation in this project chat after collection
assessment: Crossings were clearly visible while counting; all 36 recordings retained. Blank validity dropdowns reflect omitted form entry rather than known invalid footage.
limitations: Occasional buffering and dense pedestrian groups may have caused an occasional missed crossing. No independent recount or second annotator verification was performed. Some people walked partway and returned, requiring consistent observer judgment. The observer expressed confidence but no numerical accuracy percentage was independently measured.
playback: Varying playback speeds, confirmed by observer; at least one collection screenshot shows 2.4x.
